subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECT pair.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lactic acid — 4 carbon molecules**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lactic acid** is an organic acid with the chemical formula **C3H6O3**.
 
• It contains **3 carbon atoms**, not 4.
 
• Lactic acid is produced in muscles during intense activity where oxygen levels are low, leading to anaerobic respiration.
 
• It is also found in sour milk products, such as yogurt and kefir, due to the fermentation process by lactic acid bacteria.
 
• Lactic acid plays a significant role in various biochemical processes and is used in the food, pharmaceutical, and cosmetic industries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Pyruvate — 3 carbon molecules**__

 __
 
• **Pyruvate** is a key intermediate in several metabolic pathways throughout the cell.
 
• It is a **3-carbon molecule** with the chemical formula **C3H4O3**.
 
• Pyruvate is formed during glycolysis and can be further processed to either lactic acid or enter the mitochondria for aerobic respiration.
 
 
 
• **Ethanol — 2 carbon molecules**__
 __
 
• **Ethanol**, commonly known as alcohol, has the chemical formula **C2H5OH**.
 
• It contains **2 carbon atoms**.
 
• Ethanol is widely used as a recreational substance and is also used in the medical and industrial fields as a disinfectant and solvent.
 
 
 
• **Glucose — 6 carbon molecules**__
 
 
• **Glucose** is a simple sugar with the chemical formula **C6H12O6**.
 
• It contains **6 carbon atoms**.
 
• Glucose is a primary source of energy for living organisms and is a crucial component of cellular respiration.
 
• It is found naturally in fruits and other parts of plants and is the main product of photosynthesis.
